item.text: {"rubric":[{"claim_id":"c1","claim_type":"core","weight":30,"statement":"It states that `f1_score` clamps both precision and recall into `[0.0, 1.0]` before computing F1, so out-of-range grader numbers are normalized rather than propagated raw.","span_ids":["s1"]},{"claim_id":"c2","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"It shows that `SemanticF1.forward` takes the semantic judge's `scores.precision` and `scores.recall`, passes them to `f1_score`, and returns the resulting numeric `Prediction.score` when `trace` is not passed.","span_ids":["s2","s5"]},{"claim_id":"c3","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"The repro configures `dspy` with `DummyLM` returning a semantic-judge-shaped dict containing `reasoning`, `precision`, and `recall`.","span_ids":["s3"]},{"claim_id":"c4","claim_type":"supporting","weight":10,"statement":"The repro calls `SemanticF1()` with `dspy.Example(question=..., response=...)` and `dspy.Prediction(response=...)`, matching the fields read inside `forward`.","span_ids":["s2","s4"]},{"claim_id":"c5","claim_type":"core","weight":20,"statement":"Using judge outputs `precision=1.7` and `recall=-0.4`, it prints and asserts `result.score == 0.0`, proving the clamp path yields `1.0` and `0.0` before F1 is computed.","span_ids":["s1","s2"]}],"evidence":[{"span_id":"s1","path":"dspy/evaluate/auto_evaluation.py","start_line":36,"end_line":39},{"span_id":"s2","path":"dspy/evaluate/auto_evaluation.py","start_line":58,"end_line":62},{"span_id":"s3","path":"tests/evaluate/test_auto_evaluation.py","start_line":62,"end_line":74},{"span_id":"s4","path":"tests/evaluate/test_auto_evaluation.py","start_line":76,"end_line":82},{"span_id":"s5","path":"tests/evaluate/test_auto_evaluation.py","start_line":84,"end_line":86}]}
